info.description: RAG engine on Postgres alone: hybrid retrieval, verifiable citations, tenant isolation. Errors use the envelope `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}` (docs/guides/errors.md).
info.title: Footnote

get.description: Process alive (503 while draining for shutdown).
Dependencies reachable and configuration sound; 503 with the problems otherwise.

post.description: Register a space and its partial HNSW index (idempotent by name).

delete.description: Drop a space and its index (409 `space_in_use` while a collection uses it).
Revoke every key now; data, keys and the tenant row go with a `tenant_delete` job.

patch.description: Change the name and/or quotas (omitted quota fields keep their value).

get.description:
Stream the tenant's collections (no webhook secrets), documents, versions,
elements, chunks and memberships; vectors and originals (base64) on request.
Keys of a tenant ordered by id: prefix, name, timestamps, revoked (never the key).

post.description: Issue an API key; the key is returned once.

Issue a replacement (returned once); the old key stays valid for
`auth.key_rotation_grace`.

get.description: Collections, documents, chunks, vectors and stored bytes of a tenant.

post.description: Create a collection (settings default from config); a webhook secret is returned once.

delete.description: Hide the collection now; a `collection_delete` job removes its rows.

get.description: A collection with counts, active space, re-embed progress and jobs in progress.
